title: SentEmailsLog
description: Append-only log of every successfully-sent application email. Sharded by month once size > 500. Shared by Flutter app and Chrome extension.

currentShard.description: fileName of the active shard, e.g. 'sent_emails_2026-05.json'. Reads MUST follow this pointer when loading recent history.

entries.description: Entries in the *current* file only. Older entries live in shard files referenced by name pattern.

recipientHash.description: First 8 hex chars of sha256(recipient_email_lowercased). Allows dedup without storing PII.

subject.description: Subject line for user-facing history. NOT body.

sourceUrl.description: LinkedIn / Indeed page the email was extracted from (extension only).
